build-and-crush.title: Build and Crush - Multiplayer Building & Crushing Game
build-and-crush.slogan: Build and Crush: Create, Destroy, and Have Fun!
build-and-crush.description: Build and Crush is a thrilling multiplayer game where you can unleash your creativity by building structures and then demolish them for maximum fun. Whether you're into construction or destruction, Build and Crush offers endless entertainment. Join now and experience the ultimate building and crushing adventure!

HomeIframe.title: Build and Crush
HomeIframe.description: Build and Crush is a multiplayer game where you can create and destroy structures. Join the fun now!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Build and Crush is a multiplayer game where you can build and destroy structures for endless fun.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Start by building structures using the available tools.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Invite friends to join your game and collaborate on creations.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Crush your creations and watch them collapse in spectacular fashion.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Play with friends and build or destroy together.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Use a variety of tools to construct unique structures.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Crash and demolish your creations with realistic physics.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Build and Crush offers limitless ways to play and have fun.
